How we score casinos

Seven criteria with fixed weights. Every score comes from a real test and has a written reason. The overall score is calculated, never typed.

Criteria and weights

  1. Safety and licence23%

    Licence, identity checks, responsible-gambling tools and clear terms.

  2. Withdrawals23%

    Measured with real test withdrawals: speed, limits and cancellations.

  3. Games14%

    Size and quality of the catalogue, studios, search and filters.

  4. Live casino9%

    Number of live tables, tables in the local language, stream quality.

  5. App9%

    Native apps, speed, deposits and limits from the phone.

  6. Support14%

    Hours, channels and how fast and well our test questions were answered.

  7. Bonuses9%

    Value and fairness of bonus terms, where the market allows bonuses.

How we test

For each casino we open a real account, pass verification, deposit, play, request at least five withdrawals and contact support at different times.

How often

We retest every three months or when a casino changes something important. The test date is on every review.

How we make money

We earn commission when you sign up through our links. Commission is not part of any score, and we do not sell ranking positions.
